title: OpenTTD converted to 3D!
author: 8bitstargazer
selftext:
Ive always wanted to cruise big cities in 3d on OpenTTD so i have been working on this as a side project.

You can go first person view on your vehicles and rotate / zoom in however you want in a 3d space.

The Temperate region is done and fully playable with simulation features and a 3d menu toggle in game.

Download \~ [OpenTTD\_3D](https://github.com/jordanmckin/OpenTTD_3D)

comments.author: AssistBorn4589
comments.body:
>                     GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
>                       Version 3, 29 June 2007

While I hugelly appreciate that you haven't gone closed-source as it seems to be tradition on this sub, OpenTTD is GPL2, not GPL2-or-later. Honestly, I'm not 100% sure if you did code from the scratch, but if not, this may be just a little bit illegal, you can't just switch licences like that.

On the other hand, gods, this is dream come true. I need to spend evening getting this to run on Linux now.
